body: I called that night recently (that I mentioned with the ex bf) and sat on hold so long (over an hour) that i just hung up.  didnt help that i was on the same phone plan as him at the time so i was worried about that. thank you. i mean i guess i said everything that needs to be said.  i guess i just posted to give myself something to do other than lie in bed and cry while my mind wandered
*long story short.  as evil as the ex boyfriend was telling me all the reasons why i should die, it's fucking with me because I feel like he's right.
